url_citation.title: Window vacuums for DIYers | Bosch DIY
url_citation.content:
The only window vacuum with trusted Bosch wiper blade technology, for an easier glide and faster results. Perfect for cleaning windows and mirrors, as well as showers and spillages. Cleaning your home has never been so easy.

...

The cordless Bosch window vacuums are extremely versatile. They are suitable for all smooth surfaces, such as windows, mirrors, tiles, showers, and car windows. They also safely vacuum up condensation and spilled liquids. What’s more, your job can be made even easier with the various attachments that can be added quickly and easily.

...

Cordless window vacuums work similarly to traditional squeegees, but with one big difference. With a squeegee, you have to wipe up the water that collects on the windowpanes by hand. A window vacuum, on the other hand, sucks liquids directly from the window surface into an integrated tank, by using a mechanism similar to a regular household vacuum.
